from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single share count entry extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as identified in the document")
    share_class: str | None = Field(description="The class of shares (e.g. Common, Preferred, Voting Common)")
    count: float | None = Field(description="The numeric share count as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the reported count (e.g. 'shares', 'thousands')")
    date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting date associated with this share count")
    section: str | None = Field(description="The financial statement section where this was found (e.g. 'Balance Sheet', 'Cover Page')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed output for a single financial document."""
    share_records: list[ShareRecord]
